content.recommendation: ICD therapy is recommended to reduce sudden cardiac death in patients with symptomatic HF (NYHA Class II–III) and LVEF ≤35% despite optimal medical therapy for >3 months and at least 6 weeks after MI who are expected to survive for at least 1 year with good functional status.
content.additional_notes: Earlier text on page: NOACs are the preferred drugs (citations 583, 584, 587).
